name: searchAttraction
description: To search for attractions based on name, type, and location, with the capability to specify returned fields.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: The name of the attraction.

optional_parameters.name: type
optional_parameters.description: The type of attraction.

optional_parameters.name: area
optional_parameters.description: The location area of the attraction.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: A list specifying the fields to be returned. Options can include various attributes of the attractions.

name: searchHotel
description: To search for hotels based on a set of criteria including rating, type, amenities, location, and price range.

optional_parameters.name: stars
optional_parameters.description: The hotel rating based on stars.

optional_parameters.name: type
optional_parameters.description: The type of hotel.

optional_parameters.name: parking
optional_parameters.description: Availability of parking at the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: internet
optional_parameters.description: Availability of internet service at the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: area
optional_parameters.description: The location area of the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: The name of the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: priceRange
optional_parameters.description: The price range of the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: A list specifying the fields to be returned.

name: bookHotel
description: To book hotels by providing booking date, hotel name, duration of stay, number of people, and specifying fields to be returned.

optional_parameters.name: day
optional_parameters.description: The booking date.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: The hotel name for the booking.

optional_parameters.name: stay
optional_parameters.description: The number of days to stay at the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: people
optional_parameters.description: The number of people for the booking.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: Fields to be returned after booking.

name: searchTaxi
description: Provides a taxi search service, allowing users to find available taxis and get pricing based on specific criteria.

required_parameters.name: departure
required_parameters.description: The starting point of the journey

required_parameters.name: destination
required_parameters.description: The end point of the journey

required_parameters.name: return_info
required_parameters.description: A list of additional details the user wants to get back, with options including 'all', 'phone', 'license_plate', 'type'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.

optional_parameters.name: day
optional_parameters.description: The date for which the taxi service is required.

optional_parameters.name: leaveAt
optional_parameters.description: The desired departure time (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

optional_parameters.name: arriveBy
optional_parameters.description: The time by which the user wants to arrive at the destination (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

name: BookTaxi
description: Allows users to book a taxi by providing the necessary details.

required_parameters.name: license_plate
required_parameters.description: License plate number of the taxi to be booked

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: A list of details to be returned after booking, options include 'all', 'isSuccess', 'phone', 'type', 'reference'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.
